metrics.name: gst_schedule_count
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tax_rates WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND tax_kind = 'gst' AND source_table = 'SalesTaxSchedule'

metrics.name: gst_schedule_rate_total
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rate), 0) FROM public.tax_rates WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND tax_kind = 'gst' AND source_table = 'SalesTaxSchedule'
